commands._top:
usage: gext [-h] [--version] [--no-color] [--no-compile-schemas] [-D | -F]
            {list,ls,search,show,install,i,uninstall,update,u,enable,disable,preferences,p,config}
            ...

Gnome Shell extensions manager

positional arguments:
  {list,ls,search,show,install,i,uninstall,update,u,enable,disable,preferences,p,config}
    list (ls)           list installed extensions
    search              search for extensions
    show                show extensions details
    install (i)         install extensions
    uninstall           uninstall extensions
    update (u)          update extensions
    enable              enable extensions
    disable             disable extensions
    preferences (p, config)
                        edit preferences of extension

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --no-color            disable colors and style in output text (you can also
                        set NO_COLOR=1 instead of using this option)
  --no-compile-schemas  when using filesystem backend, do not compile schemas
                        with glib-compile-schemas if needed
  -D, --dbus            force DBus backend
  -F, --filesystem      force filesystem backend
commands.disable:
usage: gext disable [-h] [--not-installed] [UUID ...]

positional arguments:
  UUID             uuid of extensions to disable

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --not-installed  disable all extensions which are not installed
commands.enable:
usage: gext enable [-h] UUID [UUID ...]

positional arguments:
  UUID        uuid of extensions to enable

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
commands.install:
usage: gext install [-h] UUID_OR_PK [UUID_OR_PK ...]

positional arguments:
  UUID_OR_PK  uuid (or pk) of extensions to install

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
commands.list:
usage: gext list [-h] [-v] [--only-uuid] [-a]

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  -v, --verbose  display more information
  --only-uuid    display only uuid of extensions
  -a, --all      list all extensions, (by default only enabled are shown)
commands.search:
usage: gext search [-h] [-v] [-l LIMIT] motif [motif ...]

positional arguments:
  motif                 search motif

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -v, --verbose         search for extensions
  -l LIMIT, --limit LIMIT
                        limit to N items
commands.show:
usage: gext show [-h] [-v] UUID_OR_PK [UUID_OR_PK ...]

positional arguments:
  UUID_OR_PK     uuid (or pk) of extensions

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  -v, --verbose  display more information
commands.uninstall:
usage: gext uninstall [-h] UUID [UUID ...]

positional arguments:
  UUID        uuid of extensions to uninstall

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
commands.update:
usage: gext update [-h] [-i] [-y | -n] [--user] [UUID_OR_PK ...]

positional arguments:
  UUID_OR_PK     uuid (or pk) of extensions to update (default: all enabled
                 extensions)

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  -i, --install  install extension if not installed
  -y, --yes      do not prompt confirmation for update/install
  -n, --dry-run  do not update nor install anything, a return code 17 is
                 returned if updates are available
  --user         only update /user extensions, ignore /system ones
